description: Ministry of Mass Media - Post Office Ordinance Money Orders Issued With effect from 01.01.2021 to 31.12.2021
reasoning: This gazette contains rules and regulations regarding Money Orders issued under the Post Office Ordinance, specifying validity periods, refund procedures, and exceptional circumstances for claims. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for financial transactions through postal services, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
